'''Ylla Nalooma''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]] who worked in the restaurant of the [[Sanads of Rorkee]] [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]]. A pompous person, she believed that her work was beyond her capabilities.
